message.content:
The average (median) home price in California is roughly **$800 000–$900 000**.  
- Zillow’s 2024 Home Value Index lists the median home value in California at about **$800 k**.  
- The median price varies by region: San Francisco Bay Area and Los Angeles are above $1 M, while Central Valley and Inland Empire are closer to $500 k–$600 k.  

So, if you’re looking for a ball‑park figure, you can expect the average Californian home to cost somewhere in the **$800 k–$900 k** range.
